posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
If you had the option to choose your inital 4 card hand, what would you take? Obviously there isn't a "one size fits all", as different villains call for different tools, so feel free to be creative with it. 

I'll start with what one of the easier characters for such a list.

Waith: 2 Impromptu Inventions, Grappling Hook, MicroTargeting Computer: This pretty much gives you a complete first turn damage setup with a Grappling Hook as safety net. I'd take this hand vs any boss, any day.

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
Mr. Fixer: Driving Mantis, Dual Crowbars, Overdrive, Toolbox.

Slightly on the offense side, being able to deal either 1 target 4 damage or 2 targets 2 damage. Yets still able to toss some environment/villain damage on occasion for some protection. Early overdrive to ensure that Salvage Yard will be able to retrieve one. Toolbox to give the extra cards to get Charge/Overdrive/Bloody Knuckles or replacement tools or styles if needed.

posts.cooked:
Absolute Zero: Onboard Module Installation, Onboard Module Installation, Onboard Module Installation, Impale.

*The Dreamer.
